description.content:
This endpoint provides OpenAI-compatible chat completions using stakai for inference.

Model format: `provider/model` (e.g., `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`)

Supported providers:
- `anthropic`: Claude models
- `openai`: GPT models
- `google`: Gemini models
- `fireworks-ai`: DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, MiniMax, ERNIE, Kimi models (via Fireworks.ai)

Headers:
- `Authorization`: Bearer token (required)
